description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontGulf Front Views- Beach Chairs* - Ground Floor Unit - Blue Mountain Townhomes 4BThe Space Blue Mountain Villas 4B – Gulf-Front Getaway with Stunning Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Gulf-Front Condo – Unbeatable panoramic beachfront views Private Beach Access – Direct staircase to the sugar-white sands 1 Bedroom / 1 Bathroom – Sleeps up to 6 guests comfortably King Master Suite – Cozy & inviting with plush bedding Queen Sleeper Sofa + Bunk Beds – Extra space for family & friends Walk-Out Patio with Amazing Views – Perfect for morning coffee & sunset cocktails Six-Foot Sliding Glass Doors – Stunning Gulf views from the open-concept living space Walking Distance to Shops & Dining – Close to local restaurants & 30A hotspots Only 4 Miles to Seaside – Easy access to shopping, dining & entertainment Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected during your stay Assigned Parking + Overflow Parking – Hassle-free parking for guests Private Beach Access Fob Included – Secure, easy entry to your exclusive beachfront Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacation Multi-Family Option – Book Unit 4A above for additional space & flexibilityWelcome to BMV 4BEnjoy all that the Emerald Coast has to offer when you stay at this charming, one bedroom beach haven tucked away in the serene area of Blue Mountain Beach. With unbeatable Gulf front views and accommodations for six, this impeccably kept townhome offers the perfect spot to bring the family on your next beach vacation. Take in the beautiful scenery while you lounge on the townhome's private walkout balcony or head down to the white sandy beaches via the private beach access. Six-foot wide sliding glass doors allow for unobstructed views of the white sandy beach from the open kitchen, dining and living areas. When you aren't spending the day at the beach, be sure to check out the variety of shopping and dining venues along 30A in the neighboring Seaside and WaterColor!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Multiple Families or guests? SEE UNIT 4A in the same complex located just above. 4A is a two-story, two-bedroom unit located just above this unit.** One free set of beach chairs included for reservations booked for Memorial Day through Labor Day.**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4):Master Bedroom - King BedBuilt in Bunk Beds - Twin over Twin BunkAREA ATTRACTIONS:Welcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures.Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep.Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay! Show less
